description: Erection of two pre-fabricated modular buildings to provide office/welfare building and weighbridge office following removal of existing modular buildings
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Site Location Plan, PTK19-01, PTK19-02, PTK19-03, OPP1209985_1 Elevation Rev. A, OPP1209985 Elevation Rev. A, OPP1209985_4 - received 08/10/2020.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building or as set out in the application

Condition : 4 - Within three months of the substantial installation or completion of the modular buildings hereby approved the existing buildings shown on the plans hereby approved to be replaced, shall have been removed in their entirety and any debris disposed of off site
